metaDescription: Custom website for Reacon Group, a Sydney print, packaging and mailing business: service lines, industry pages, sister company links and an order CTA.
summary: Custom-built B2B website for a Sydney print, packaging, mailing and data communications company.
overview: Reacon Group presents itself as a global print, packaging and communications partner, producing everything from packaging and retail activations to personalized mail from its Sydney production floor. Pixel2Tech built the Reacon Group website as white-label development partner for a digital agency, delivering a custom site for the agency's client.
challenge: Reacon sells three quite different services, print and production, mailing and fulfillment, and data-driven communications, to buyers in regulated sectors such as banking, pharmaceuticals and government. It is also one company in a wider group, so the site has to explain where it fits and point to its sister businesses without losing visitors.
approach: A floating pill navigation links About Us, Solutions, Our Industries, Our Works and Blogs, with Start an Order and Contact Us buttons always in view. The home page opens on a dark hero with the brand's positioning and two calls to action, then a client logo strip, a certifications row, an introduction to the group with cards for its four sister companies, and three long service sections that each list capabilities and link to a detail page. An industries section, partner quotes, an FAQ and a closing call to action complete the page.
outcome: A B2B website that explains three service lines and six industries from one home page and gives procurement teams a direct route to start an order or contact the team. The four sister companies are one click away, so visitors who need a different service can still find it within the group.

process.title: Structure
process.body: Solutions are grouped into print and production, mailing and fulfillment, and data-driven innovation, each with sub-pages such as commercial print, direct mail, warehousing and data unification.

process.title: Trust signals
process.body: Client logos, a row of the certifications the company holds and partner quotes sit high on the home page, where B2B buyers look for them first.

process.title: Group and industries
process.body: Cards link out to the four sister companies in the Westman Group, and an industries section covers banking and finance, hospitality, e-commerce, pharmaceuticals, charities and government.

process.title: Build and mobile
process.body: The site is built with Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js and GSAP scroll animations, and on phones the hero, buttons and service sections stack into one column behind a menu button.

whyItMatters: B2B buyers comparing print and mailing suppliers want to see capabilities, sector experience and credentials before they make contact. A site that puts all three on one page, with an order route always visible, shortens that research.

faqs.q: What is the Reacon Group website built with?
faqs.a: It is a custom build using Tailwind CSS for styling, Alpine.js for interactive elements and GSAP for scroll animations, served from a Microsoft IIS server.

faqs.q: Do you work white-label for agencies?
faqs.a: Yes. We build Shopify stores and websites under the agency's brand, with an NDA when needed, so the work is presented as the agency's own. Share the scope and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
